title: Users can filter the invoice list by date range
description: Add a date range filter to the invoice list view. Users should be able to select a start and end date and see only invoices within that range. The filter should apply both to the visible list and to any exports triggered from the filtered view.
acceptance_criteria: The feature works correctly and all tests pass. Functions as expected without errors.

metadata.intent: Allow users to narrow the invoice list to a specific time window for easier navigation and reporting.
